query:
SELECT data, empresaSlug, tenantId, cat1, cat2, cat3, lancadoPor 
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('SERAPHINE', 'seraphine', 'barbiero-seraphine') 
AND data IN ('2026-05-05', '2026-05-06', '2026-05-07')
ORDER BY data, empresaSlug, tenantId;
